# Captured 2026-07-25 from the pinned av-worker build (ffmpeg version n8.1.2,
# `octoconv-av-worker:dev`, digest 772ab12cf0b1), via:
#   docker run --rm -v "$PWD/cap":/cap --entrypoint ffmpeg octoconv-av-worker:dev \
#     -y -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=20:size=1280x720:rate=30 \
#     -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=1000:duration=20 \
#     -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -crf 18 -c:a aac \
#     -progress /cap/progress.txt -nostats -f mp4 /cap/out.mp4
# NOTE: this build's ffmpeg is compiled with `--enable-protocol='file,crypto'`
# only (--disable-everything base) -- the "pipe" protocol used by
# `-progress pipe:N` in prior research sketches is NOT registered in this
# binary ("Failed to open progress URL \"pipe:1\": Protocol not found"), so
# this fixture was captured via `-progress <file>` (the "file" protocol,
# which IS enabled) instead of a pipe/fd transport. The emitted block
# CONTENT/FORMAT is identical either way -- ffmpeg's progress-print logic in
# fftools/ffmpeg.c is transport-agnostic; only the URL scheme differs. Plan
# 02 (streaming exec) MUST account for this: `-progress pipe:3` will not work
# against the real pinned binary and needs a different transport (e.g. a
# named FIFO via the "file" protocol, or rebuilding with the pipe protocol
# enabled) -- flagged for the next plan, not resolved here (out of scope for
# the pure parser layer this fixture feeds).
